digest.component_or_area: review-kernel finding schema and finalization pipeline
propositions: Review-kernel findings currently stamp severity at five return sites in pass3_decide (lines 673, 690, 706, 724, 740) and must stop emitting the severity key entirely
The shim.py _to_common_finding function backfills missing severity to _SEVERITY_DEFAULT='medium' via map lookup, defeating omission at the source
The findings.py normalize_finding function unconditionally re-stamps absent severity to 'info', silently reintroducing the field downstream despite source omission
The shared common.schema.json finding definition must have severity removed from its required list while keeping the property definition for other producers
Non-review-kernel producers (completion_reconcile, spec_scan, workflow gates) always supply severity and must remain unaffected by the narrowed clamp logic in normalize_finding
